label: D2: arrived at S2 via common transition (a2 -> S2)
explanation: Fires almost only at the D2 step (>99.9% of mass) when the state input shows S2. Its strongest form is when the agent chose a2 and reached S2 by the common transition. Both the action and the state are observed at D2 (in_action and in_state), so the predicate uses no future variables. Reaching S2 by a rare transition (a1 -> S2) gives only weak or no activation: those are most of the misses, which sit in the lowest activation quartile. It never fires at D1 or GO, never on S1, and never when the reward input is 1. On dev, phase==D2 & in_state==2 alone gets recall 1.0 but precision 0.77; adding action==2 raises F1 from 0.87 to 0.93 with 0.99 mass recall. Adding prev_reward==1 does not help. I did not analyse magnitude within the common a2->S2 case further, beyond noting that activation rate rises with the value head.

issues: Most of the false positives fall in one systematic class the explanation never mentions: the end of the episode. Activation rate by ep_trial is about 0.14 up to trial 89, then 0.044 for trials 90-99. Precision of the predicate per trial: 0.97 at ep_trial 86, 0.95 at 88, 0.84 at 90, 0.57 at 92, 0.17 at 94, 0.01 at 96 and 0.0 at 98. Restricted to ep_trial>=90 the predicate has precision 0.32; restricted to ep_trial<90 it has precision 0.997 (dev). So the roughly 7% of predicted-but-inactive steps are almost all late-episode common a2->S2 trials, not scattered noise.

The claim 'activation rate rises with the value head' probably reflects the same episode-time effect. Value falls as the episode nears its end, and the feature shuts off there too; this should not be presented as a separate finding.

The other claims check out on dev. D2 holds 1.000 of the activation mass, and GO has 44 of 380619 steps active, which is negligible. There are 0 active steps on S1, 0 at D1, and 0 when the reward input is 1. Rare a1->S2 has precision 0.24 and holds 0.97% of the mass, so the 'weak or no activation' claim holds; that case accounts for most of the remaining misses (lowest-quartile coverage 0.71).
The test-split score of the original predicate reproduces: F1 0.929, precision 0.931, recall 0.926, mass recall 0.99.

ep_trial is not an input to the agent. Because episodes have a fixed length, the agent can track elapsed time internally (or through a correlated value estimate), so this gating is legitimate content the feature carries. Either way, the label should state it.
